circuit.name: Three-Phase 3-Level NPC Inverter (Closed-Loop AC Inverter via PD PWM)
circuit.description: Three-phase three-level Neutral Point Clamped (NPC) inverter with closed-loop AC voltage regulation via Phase Disposition (PD) PWM and continuous-time PI control with voltage feed-forward. Converts a stiff 800V split-rail DC link (two 400V rails anchored at midpoint neutral n6) to a clean 380V line-to-line RMS (310.27V peak line-to-neutral) 50Hz sinusoidal AC output across star-connected 2.888 Ohm loads (50kW total). Each phase leg uses four NMOS switches (SW1-SW4) and two clamping diodes (D_CLAMP_P, D_CLAMP_N) producing three voltage levels (+400V, 0V, -400V) at switch node n5 relative to midpoint n6, with 10kHz carrier triangle modulation and 500ns interlocking dead-time delay.
